builds.name: Reference: Physical pick
builds.goal: Reference for Zed: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A shadow-based assassin who lines up overlapping shurikens, uses swaps for positioning and concentrates damage inside Death Mark's timed window. Record shadow placement, overlapping shuriken hits and actual Death Mark window damage. Mark repeats eligible recorded damage, not every hypothetical item/proc in the build. Lethality, approach speed and armor penetration favor short physical pick windows.
builds.summary: Lethality, approach speed and armor penetration favor short physical pick windows.
testPlan: Kit question for Zed: Record shadow placement, overlapping shuriken hits and actual Death Mark window damage. Mark repeats eligible recorded damage, not every hypothetical item/proc in the build.

Start with the early core (Youmuu, then Profane Hydra) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Resource: Energy. Do not treat mana regeneration as Energy recovery; Nimbus replaces Manaflow when that Sorcery row is used.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Lethality, approach speed and armor penetration favor short physical pick windows. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Zed and his shadows throw their shurikens.

Each shuriken deals damage to every enemy hit. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.

builds.name: Marked attack filler
builds.summary: Test one real attack between shadow abilities and Death Mark expiry.
builds.goal: Test one real attack between shadow abilities and Death Mark expiry.
builds.hypothesis: R records a three-second damage window; Q/shadows supply physical hits and W returns energy when matching abilities hit. Trinity supports one actual post-cast attack, BotRK adds a current-health packet and passive adds conditional magic damage below half health. The mark repeat must be logged without assuming every proc counts.
testPlan: Required state: R mark active, finite energy, target below half for passive and Spellblade ready.
Compare R-Q-E versus the same sequence plus one attack, isolating passive/item and final mark packets.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: The attack delays a multi-shuriken hit or exposes Zed before escape.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: W shadow Q casts do not themselves consume attack Spellblade.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Trinity Force, Blade of The Ruined King, Serylda's Grudge, Edge of Night, Guardian Angel, Ionian Boots of Lucidity. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Slash-driven shadow recycle
builds.summary: Use actual Zed E champion contact to shorten W and produce a second escape/attack angle.
builds.goal: Use actual Zed E champion contact to shorten W and produce a second escape/attack angle.
builds.hypothesis: E by Zed reduces W cooldown three seconds per champion hit; shadow E adds slow but overlapping slashes deal no extra damage. Shojin haste and physical Cleaver pressure test a longer exchange, with Eclipse and Deaths Dance supporting survival. E contact and W energy refund must be earned, not assumed from every shadow.
testPlan: Required state: Record energy and W state; Zed own E reaches one or more champions safely.
Log W timer after Zed E versus shadow-only E and count energy refunds for matched Q hits.

Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Only the shadow reaches the target, so the planned W cooldown reduction fails.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Overlapping E slashes do not each deal full damage or each independently grant the own-E W refund.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
